# Step 2.123: team fouls that reset each half or once a game

## Builder one: the engine and core (layer 1)

**What exists.** The engine's rules gain `teamFoulsReset` (`'period' | 'half' | 'game'`), absent being each period (`packages/sports/src/basketball/live.ts`: the type, `TEAM_FOULS_RESETS`, `foulWindow`, the count in `derive`, kept by `checkRules` when given and refused when wrong). `periodFouls`, the bonus and the double bonus follow the window. Overtime continues the last regulation window's count: S-114, decided for you (P7 is silent; the engine already did this for each period). `engineRulesOf` carries the season's choice only when it counts differently from each period (once a game, or each half with quarters), like the other optional rules (T-420); `trackerEngineRulesOf` drops it, since a game brought over was counted each period. A started game keeps its rules (S-1, through `withCurrentRules`, tested). The note in `engine-rules.ts` is corrected (M8, L8). The platform's command shape (`PlatformRules` in `packages/contracts/src/live-stats.ts`) takes it; the Al-Hadi shape still refuses it. P7 §1 and T6 (T-128's section) are corrected; rows in `decisions-pending/S-114.md` and `T-420.md`. No migration.

**Tests.** New `tests/live-stats-team-fouls-reset.test.mjs` (9): the audit's example first (4 in Q1, 3 in Q2, by the half: 7 and the bonus in Q2; each period: 3, none), Q3 starting again, double bonus, once a game, overtime for each reset, undo/redo/unfoul, a foul moved back across a period line (by a period change and by editing the play's period, as a grid correction does), the format keeping and refusing the field, the device engine agreeing, and the random-plays test (ten seeds, quarters and halves, 300 random commands each: "each period" absent and present give the same derived game after every command and the same state but for the field). Also `engine-rules.test.ts` (+4, and the "custom" case now expects `teamFoulsReset: 'half'`, which is the admin's value carried) and `live-stats.test.ts` (+1).

**Broken by hand.** `foulWindow`'s half returning the period: 5 engine tests failed; its once-a-game returning the period: 2 failed; its default read as 'half': the random test and 3 more failed; `teamFoulsResetOf` dropping 'half': 4 core tests failed. Each put back.

**Run.** Before: `tests/live-stats-*.test.mjs` 143 of 143; vitest on sports, games and contracts 714 in 72 files. After, with no existing engine or live-stats test file edited: the same 143 of 143 (the new file apart); vitest on core, contracts, sports and `tracker-commands.test.ts` 2306 in 226 files; `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (442 of 442) pass.

**Left for layer 2.** The tracker's badge and horn already read `periodFouls` (`apps/web/src/features/tracker/scoring-view.ts` line 289), so they follow, but their words may still say "this period"; the public page and the live snapshot should be checked the same way. Season settings still hold the choice back (`teamFoulsResetFor` in `apps/web/src/features/season-settings/season-parts.ts` forces each period with quarters and turns once a game into each half with halves, step 2.47's rule): offer each half with quarters and once a game, and the game-format panel likewise. A browser test (quarters by the half: 7 fouls, the badge and the horn in Q2, on the public page too). The pinned lists for anything new.

**What I distrust.** No season can reach the engine with a value that matters until the settings let one (so nothing in the product shows it yet). A season changed while a game is live keeps the old count for that game by design (S-1); the admin may not expect it. The random test draws from the commands the engine knows today; a new command type is not in it.

**Lines in other lanes' folders.** Lane 2.65's `packages/core/src/modules/games`: `engine-rules.ts` (the header note, lines 9 to 15; `trackerEngineRulesOf` and the new `teamFoulsResetOf`, lines 31 to 56; one line in `engineRulesOf`, line 82) and `engine-rules.test.ts` (one import, three lines in "carries every value the admin set", and a new block at the end). `apply-plays.ts` is not touched.

## Review

**Run.** No engine test and no `tests/live-stats-*.test.mjs` that existed was edited; they pass, 152 of 152 with the new file, and vitest on sports, `engine-rules`, contracts `live-stats` and `live-game` 175 of 175. A throwaway replay (lane `.local/replay-same.mjs`): `build/stage-1`'s `live.ts` and this one with the rule absent, five formats (quarters, halves, both on the game clock, a foul limit), 300 seeds of 400 random commands (fouls, unfouls, undo, redo, periods 1 to 7, subs, timeouts, end, reopen): byte-identical state and `derive` after 45,655 accepted commands, and the same refusal words for 74,345. A throwaway attack (`.local/attack.test.mjs`, 7 tests) passes: Q1 or Q2 fouls taken back in Q2 or Q3, a period set back from Q3 to Q2 and forwards again, the bonus and double bonus at the limit and one below, OT1 and OT2 going on with the second half, once a game never starting again, halves "each half" matching "each period" after every command, and a wrong value refused in words (`'quarter'`, `null`, `2`, `''`). The engine has no kinds of foul, so the window cannot change which fouls count: every foul counts, and turnovers and timeouts never do. Broken by hand: `checkRules` dropping the field, and test 7 of the new file failed; restored. S-1 is covered by `engine-rules.test.ts`. I did not open the browser: the public page was judged from the code and its unit test.

**Medium.** `apps/web/src/features/season-settings/season-parts.ts` (the save reads the radio as it is). With 2.47's forcing gone, a season made from the default (halves, `'half'`) and switched to quarters keeps `'half'`, so from its next game the bonus is counted by the half unless the admin changes the new radio. Its scheduled games change too (`withCurrentRules`). That is the admin's setting, now obeyed, but a quarters league that counts each quarter gets the bonus late. To see it: default rules, set periods to 4 and save; the settings line says "each half". Change: when the periods change, set the radio to match, or say it in the help line.

**Medium.** `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-421.md`: a new sentence on every live public page ("Lions shoot the bonus."), shown for games counted each period too, is product, not technical. It is right, since it uses the same `>=` as the engine's `bonusLevel` (`live.ts` line 697) on the same `periodFouls`, but it should be an S- row, "Decided for you". It also copies `bonusLevel` (`live-game-view.tsx` lines 151 to 173), so the two can drift.

**Low.** `packages/core/src/modules/games/queries/read-game-snapshot.ts` lines 274 to 282: `foulRules` copies `state.rules` as stored, while every other field goes through `whole`. A stored state with a value the engine does not know (derive reads it as each period, with no crash) gives a snapshot that `GameSnapshotReading.safeParse` (`live-game-view.tsx` line 108) refuses as a whole, so the page stops refreshing. It has no core unit test (only the browser test).

**Low.** The scoring screen shows "7 fouls" (`clock-parts.tsx` line 125). Only the screen-reader name says "this half". A scorekeeper at a table who knows each quarter would read 7 as this quarter's count. Change: a short visible word under the number ("half", "game") when the window is not the period. With halves, "this period" (tracker and page) would be clearer as "this half".

**Low.** `tests/browser/team-fouls-half-test.mjs` lines 144 and 187: "no bonus yet" and "overtime goes on with 5" are read straight after a tap with no wait, so a slow screen still shows the old value and the check passes. The later checks, which do wait, cover both. No `.catch` swallows a failure (`step` records each).

## Fix round

**Item 1, seasons saved before (T-422, pending).** Stored values could be wrong for the new count: the game-format panel offered all three on stage 1 and the default is halves with `'half'`, so a season or game format of quarters could hold `'half'` (or `'game'`) and would have started counting by the half. No migration: `fouls.teamFoulsResetChosen` (always `true`, optional) is written only when an admin saves a choice other than each period (season settings, a game's format); absent, team fouls count each period whatever is stored. `teamFoulsCounted` in `packages/contracts` is the one reading (engine rules, the settings form and line, the format form, the start confirmation's facts); `foulsWithReset` writes it. A game-rules save with the choice left as it was keeps the stored fouls unchanged (an old season stays unmarked); halves to quarters or back with the choice left sets each half or quarter. The "Saved" sentence and the help line say what the team fouls now do, and the help line says what a change of periods does. P7 corrected.

**Item 2 (S-115, pending, decided for you).** The bonus sentence moved out of T-421 into `decisions-pending/S-115.md`; the page calls the engine's own `bonusLevel` (now exported from `packages/sports/src/basketball/live.ts`, no behaviour changed), and a unit test compares the page with the engine's derived game, quarters and halves, 1 to 12 fouls.

**Item 3.** `foulRulesOf` in `read-game-snapshot.ts` checks the field with the contract's `SnapshotFoulRules` (now exported from `tracker-protocol.ts`); a bad stored value leaves it out and the snapshot still reads. Two core tests.

**Item 4, half done.** The two reads in `team-fouls-half-test.mjs` wait with a limit (the count reaching 6, the clock showing period 5). The visible word under the scoring screen's count is NOT done (budget): it needs the four sizes and two pictures.

**Tests.** New: contracts (3), season-parts (8 in two blocks, the old builder test rewritten to the marked choice), part-words (2), format-values (1), engine-rules (1, and "carries every value" back to no `teamFoulsReset`: the custom start is unmarked), snapshot (2), live-game-view (1); `season-settings-test` +4 checks (once a game saved, the help line, quarters to halves, back to quarters and the preset again).

**Broken by hand.** `teamFoulsCounted` reading the stored value: 4 season-parts tests failed; the periods rule removed: 1 failed; the mark never written: 4 contracts and engine tests failed; the help line without the count: 1 failed; the snapshot check removed: 1 failed; the page's bonus one foul early: 3 failed. Each put back. The browser waits were not broken by hand.

**Run and passed.** `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test` (442), `npm run test:web` (288), `tests/live-stats-*.test.mjs` 152; vitest on season-settings, tracker, game-format, live-game, core games, contracts 1641 in 149 files, sports and live-game 158; browser `team-fouls-half-test` (12) with `season-settings-test` (46), then `scoring-screen-test` alone (1002).

**What I distrust.** An admin of a halves season counted "each half, also with quarters" who changes to quarters in one save and wants to keep that choice gets each half or quarter instead, because the choice, left untouched, is read as left as it was; choosing it again in a second save keeps it. The game-format panel does not apply the change-of-periods rule (it shows the choice beside the periods). A game format saved from the panel now stores the counted value, so an old format of halves with `'half'` comes back as `'period'` (the same count).

## Closing helper

**Item 1, the merge.** `build/stage-1` (steps 2.69, 2.155 part 4, 2.65) merged with no conflict: git joined both sides in `scoring-view.ts`, `clock-parts.tsx`, `engine-words.ts`, `read-game-snapshot.ts` and `engine-rules.test.ts`. `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck` and vitest on the tracker, core games and season settings (1411 in 127 files) passed after it.

**Item 2, never is kept.** The confirming look's Low: `teamFoulsSaved` (`season-parts.ts`) turned "Never: they count for the whole game", left as it was, into each half or quarter when the periods changed. Once a game does not depend on the periods, so it is now kept (marked chosen); each half still becomes each half or quarter. The help line says so ("Never stays as it is when you change between halves and quarters; …"), and the T-422 row too. Tests: `season-parts.test.ts` splits the old loop into "each half becomes each half or quarter" and "keeps never, once a game, halves to quarters and back"; `part-words.test.ts` reads the new help line; `season-settings-test` (48 checks) now sees never kept with two halves, then saves each half and back to quarters as before.

**Broken by hand.** `teamFoulsSaved` turning never into each period again: the new season-parts test failed (1 of 67). Put back. The browser test was not broken by hand.

**Item 3, the small word: not shipped.** On a phone with a bonus badge the count is already cut to "10F" and set smaller where letters are wide, so that "Double bonus" is never cut; a word beside it does not fit, and a line under it makes the scoreboard taller, which the scoring-screen test holds to a fifth of the screen. The screen-reader name still says "this half".

**Lines in other lanes' folders.** None. Shared: `packages/site/src/messages/en/admin-settings.ts` (the one help line, `seasonSettings.field.teamFoulsReset.help`) and `tests/browser/season-settings-test.mjs` (the steps after "once a game" is saved).
